mainRisks: brand_logo_text_risk: CRITICAL — beverage bottle label is clearly readable with brand name and flavor text visible; must not be reproduced in AI generation
over_editorialization_risk: HIGH — dramatic blue-hour lighting and professional composition break UGC naturalness; if regenerated for UGC must shift to natural daylight
label_typography_risk: HIGH — product label contains readable text and branding that cannot be replicated in AI generation
fake_ugc_behavior_risk: MEDIUM — product is staged beside subject without genuine interaction; creates authenticity gap if used as ugc_core
excessive_perfection_risk: MEDIUM — athletic body composition, lighting and staging are too polished for genuine UGC classification

promptBlocks.basePromptBlock: Athletic female figure in black performance activewear crouching on outdoor bleacher steps at dusk, tying sneaker laces in a pre-workout preparation gesture. A beverage bottle with a colored label sits on the bleacher surface immediately beside her foot, naturally adjacent to the action. Natural ambient light or soft golden-hour lighting. Low camera angle looking slightly upward. No face visible — body-only composition. Dynamic posture with implied movement energy. Gritty urban outdoor setting with stadium architecture. The product is present but not held — lifestyle placement communicating athletic ritual and product belonging in the fitness world.

promptBlocks.basePromptBlock: Medium shot of a creator in fitted activewear — sports bra and high-waist leggings in a muted dark tone — standing confidently in the foreground of an active outdoor restaurant terrace. Creator faces camera directly with a composed neutral expression, wearing small tinted sunglasses and minimal gold accessories. Hair is straight and long. Creator holds a lifestyle bag prop in one hand — unbranded, natural material. Natural soft daylight from above, warm skin tones. Background is populated with diners at white-cloth tables, slightly out of focus. Low-angle close-to-natural camera position. The composition communicates confident lifestyle presence — social aspiration, activewear-in-real-life energy, creator-in-their-world framing. No direct product recommendation behavior. Story-support framing with high aspirational energy.
